reuse.why: Routes every expected-amount consumer (preview, posting, updateActions, forecast, schedule template, API, desktop views) through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies the tree had and leaves the rule in one function; no new duplicated logic.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; the API list adds expectedAmount in the schedules-get handler with a dedicated APIScheduleListEntity type.

scope.why: All edits serve the requested rule changes and the API field, with tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Single definition makes future rule changes one-line, though appending op after inverse forces `false` placeholders at most call sites.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains one op parameter that carries the isapprox rule; all call sites use the helper
